site_ui.lead: Explore how practitioners select recurring and high-ticket offers, build trust through content and funnels, and track affiliate sales, calls, and leads against acquisition costs and program rules.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies with timestamped inline attribution. They examine offer selection, affiliate networks, bridge funnels, search visibility, call and lead delivery, conversion tracking, paid acquisition, newsletters, and disclosure requirements while distinguishing reported results from illustrative economics.

flow: Match products to audience problems, inspect demand and retention, apply to relevant programs, and confirm commission terms, refund windows, buyer criteria, and payment timing.
Connect opt-in pages, bridge videos, useful follow-up emails, and offer-specific destinations; for calls and leads, establish routing, delivery, and buyer acceptance requirements.

Publish reviews, comparisons, tutorials, and newsletters grounded in product experience, clear answers, and consistent entities; weigh borrowed-authority visibility against removal and reputation-abuse risk.
Test affiliate links, referral IDs, call routes, webhooks, and sold-lead events before sending traffic; verify clear disclosures, endorsement accuracy, and brand-advertising permissions.
Run bounded traffic tests, check search terms and subscriber quality, and compare acquisition costs with accepted calls, sold leads, commissions, refunds, and delayed payment.
Use conversion evidence and buyer feedback to improve content, targeting, and follow-up; expand only where margins, lead acceptance, retention, and delivery capacity support it.
